purpose: Country frontend resilience contract. A country page must remain usable when a live enrichment source, API or optional dataset fails.
missing_value_policy: Render Unknown / Not yet sourced / Not applicable according to field state. Never throw a fetch error merely because enrichment is unavailable.

live_fetch_policy.error_label: Live enrichment unavailable — repository data shown

known_issue: Previous country views could surface 'Failed to fetch' when an optional live source failed. The country route must treat live enrichment as additive, not foundational.
acceptance: Opening any canonical country ID must produce a useful local page even with network access disabled after the repository assets have loaded.
